info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Billings-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Billing Retrieval API allows organizations to access detailed billing information related to their fitness memberships. This endpoint provides insights into billing cycles, transaction histories, and any outstanding charges associated with member accounts. Typical consumers include gym administrators and finance teams who utilize this data for financial reporting and membership management. By retrieving billing details, users can ensure accurate billing practices and enhance member satisfaction through transparent communication.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve detailed billing information for their memberships, including payment history, upcoming charges, and related billing details. It is essential for maintaining transparency and providing members with their payment status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the billing information related to memberships. It is expected to contain specific parameters that define the membership in question.

204.description: The request was processed successfully, but there is no content to return.
